fact: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel advanced the pre-commercialisation phase of the Horizon cross-border terrestrial fibre corridor after a stakeholders' workshop in Addis Ababa, with colocation and hosting services expected at landing sites in Djibouti and Sudan.
title: Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Advance Horizon Cross-Border Fiber Project
